# Oyster acquires Office Options customer base

By Neil Trim on 21st August 2026

Oyster has recently announced the acquisition of the customer base of Office Options (Midlands) Ltd from the appointed liquidator. In a statement the company said its immediate focus is to ensure a seamless transition for customers, maintaining the high standards of service and support they expect. Several key members of the former Office Options team have joined Oyster.
